Question Q-1995: What day of the week was 2022-03-05?
Answer: Saturday

Calculation: January 1, 2022 was a Saturday. From Jan 1 to March 5: 31 (Jan) + 28 (Feb) + 4 (days after Mar 1) = 63 days. 63 mod 7 = 0, so March 5, 2022 was also a Saturday.
